nieuw.titel: Advance Runesmiths to project their dispel range
nieuw.tekst: Put one or two Runesmiths in units advancing up the board, and use them aggressively to bring enemy casters within dispel range.
nieuw.waarom: He says their 18-inch dispel range needs to be pushed forward to reach enemy wizards.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He does not expect this approach to stop spells on turn one.

bronnen.citaat: I really like to use run Smiths aggressively

nieuw.titel: Prefer a cheap Runesmith over a Runelord for dispelling
nieuw.tekst: For economical magic defence, he prefers a Runesmith relying on Runes of Spellbreaking rather than paying for a Runelord.
nieuw.waarom: He says a Runesmith's level-one dispelling struggles against level-four wizards. Although a Runelord dispels as level two, he still prefers keeping the investment cheap and relying on Spellbreaking.

bronnen.citaat: I don't personally see a reason to take a rune Lord

nieuw.titel: Consider Master Rune of Balance on the Anvil
nieuw.tekst: If taking Master Rune of Balance, he prefers putting it on the Anvil of Doom rather than a Runesmith.
nieuw.waarom: He thinks the extra dispel die, discarding the lowest, could help the Anvil's level-three dispelling beat level-four wizards. On a Runesmith it takes space he would use for Spellbreaking runes.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He notes that enemy wizards must be within the Anvil's 24-inch dispel range.

bronnen.citaat: I personally would want to take this on the Anvil

nieuw.titel: Overlap a central Anvil with a forward Runesmith
nieuw.tekst: Deploy the Anvil of Doom at the front and centre, with a Runesmith in a unit forward to the left. Keep their dispel areas overlapping as the Runesmith pushes outward.
nieuw.waarom: He finds this creates a wedge of dispel coverage that enemy wizards must avoid or enter knowing their spells can be stopped.

bronnen.citaat: Anvil at the front and center

extraCitaten.citaat: while keeping that inside the aura of the Anvil

nieuw.titel: Reserve Spellbreaking for Miasmic Mirage against your combat block
nieuw.tekst: In a combat-focused Dwarf army, keep a Rune of Spellbreaking available for Miasmic Mirage. Do not let less important spells bait you into spending all your runes first.
nieuw.waarom: He says Mirage can strand the combat block by preventing marching and charging, and that stopping it can decide the game.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He says he has been stuck in the middle of nowhere by this spell.

bronnen.citaat: keep them back for pivotal spells

extraCitaten.citaat: you need to stop it from going off

nieuw.titel: Let Column of Crystal resolve before breaking it next turn
nieuw.tekst: He recommends letting Column of Crystal be cast, then removing it with a Rune of Spellbreaking at the start of your own turn before charging. This leaves the rune available for Miasmic Mirage during the enemy turn.
nieuw.waarom: He says this sequence can let you stop both control spells and charge out of the position the opponent thought was blocked.

bronnen.citaat: I would let that be cast not wasting your Rune of spell breaking then

extraCitaten.citaat: as you start your turn in the enchantment phase

nieuw.titel: Put the Anvil ahead of Plague of Rust targets
nieuw.tekst: In a defensive or refused-flank shooting position, put the Anvil of Doom forward and keep likely Plague of Rust targets slightly behind it. Make the caster enter the Anvil's dispel range to reach those units.
nieuw.waarom: He warns that Plague of Rust's 21-inch range lets a careful opponent stay beyond a Runesmith's 18-inch dispel range.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He says maintaining this protection is harder when pushing forward.

bronnen.citaat: have your Anvil right at the front

nieuw.titel: Use the Anvil's double move to contain a Rust caster
nieuw.tekst: When advancing against Plague of Rust, use the Anvil's double move to position the Runesmith's unit so the enemy wizard cannot escape its dispel range.
nieuw.waarom: He says keeping the wizard within that range lets the Runesmith use Spellbreaking against the spell.

bronnen.citaat: what you can do with the double move from the Anvil

extraCitaten.citaat: where the Wizard's not going to be able to get out with your dispel range

nieuw.titel: Prioritise the Hagtree Fetish caster's Vile Tide
nieuw.tekst: Before playing Beastmen, identify which wizard carries the Hagtree Fetish. Prioritise stopping that wizard's Vile Tide with Spellbreaking.
nieuw.waarom: He says wound rerolls make the armour-ignoring spell particularly damaging, and its short range brings the caster within reach of Spellbreaking.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He considers the versions without wound rerolls less concerning.

bronnen.citaat: that's the one you're going to want to try and stop

extraCitaten.citaat: if you playing against beastmen this is the spell that you need to stop

nieuw.titel: Prioritise Spiritual Vortex when your units are bunched
nieuw.tekst: Against an Undead scream plan, use Spellbreaking to stop Spirit Leech and Spiritual Vortex. If prioritising between them, he considers the vortex more important when it can affect several clustered units.
nieuw.waarom: He says their Leadership penalties stack and make screams and Terror more dangerous. Stopping the opening barrage preserves units to retaliate against the nearby screamers.

bronnen.citaat: the most important one for me to try and stop would be the vortex

nieuw.titel: Keep units over three inches apart against Pillar of Fire
nieuw.tekst: Against Pillar of Fire, keep your units more than three inches apart. If necessary, move the front units outward on turn one to open those gaps.
nieuw.waarom: He says the template can otherwise move through a series of bunched units, whereas these gaps force it to stop and limit it to affecting one unit per turn.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He warns that the caster may stay outside dispel range, making direct magical defence difficult.

bronnen.citaat: make sure that your units are over 3 in apart

nieuw.titel: Put ward-protected units first in Pillar of Fire's path
nieuw.tekst: Against Pillar of Fire, put units with a suitable ward save at the front so they take its first hits.
nieuw.waarom: He says those units are harder to kill, and valuable targets may tempt the opponent to keep moving the spell back and forth through them.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He suggests Irondrakes with their innate five-plus ward against flaming attacks, or a large block with a five-plus ward from its BSB.

bronnen.citaat: put units that have got a ward save at the front

nieuw.titel: Stop Itchy Nuisance before it weakens your Dwarf unit
nieuw.tekst: Prioritise stopping Itchy Nuisance with your dispel tools when facing Orcs and Goblins. He stresses that its caster must come within reach of Dwarf dispelling.
nieuw.waarom: He warns that reducing Toughness, followed by Plague of Rust reducing armour, leaves the unit vulnerable to shooting and even Goblins in combat.

extraCitaten.citaat: luckily it's only got got a range of 15

nieuw.titel: Consider making your Royal Clans Runesmith the BSB
nieuw.tekst: In Royal Clans, consider combining the Runesmith and BSB roles to save points for stronger heroes and units.
nieuw.waarom: He highlights the Runesmith's ability to be the BSB as a way to cut the points spent on these roles.

bronnen.citaat: in Royal Clans a run Smith being able to be your BSB

bron.citaat: I like to put three Runes of spell breaking on these

extraCitaten.citaat: a run Smith with Runes of spell breaking in the combat block

aanvullingen.toelichting: Both recommend a Runesmith carrying three Runes of Spellbreaking in the advancing combat unit; here he gives the recommendation for combat lists generally.

overgeslagen: Skipped the introduction and closing chat, standalone rules readouts, repeated endorsements, and the unclear name of the 50-point casting-value rune. Omitted the cannon-shot follow-up because its targeting condition is unclear in the captions.
